## Fundamentals #0056: Linde: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-11-02 10:33
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-02-0056/


Linde (LIN) revenues in the third quarter amounted to 9.40 billion USD.

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (GAAP) reached 3.66 USD, while earnings per share (adjusted) was 4.59 USD.

### Company guidance

The company expects adjusted earnings per share (non-GAAP) in the fourth quarter to be 4.40–4.50 USD (an increase of 5.0% – 7.0%), and for the full year 2026 to be 17.82–17.92 USD (an increase of 8.0% – 9.0%). Capital expenditures for the full year 2026 are expected to range from 5.50 billion USD to 6.00 billion USD.

### Management commentary

According to management, the European market remains stable, but they see no evidence for a return of growth in this region in the near future. Management emphasized that growth in the electronics sector results from organic demand and is confident about this trend in subsequent quarters. In the face of rising inflation, management indicated that price increases worldwide, including in China, remain a key point of focus. Management also noted that in the long term, there will be a helium surplus in the market, therefore the company is exercising caution when setting prices in long-term contracts.

## Fundamentals #0055: DexCom: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-11-02 10:23
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-02-0055/


DexCom (DXCM) revenues in the third quarter were 1.34 billion USD (+11.2% y/y), while earnings per share (adjusted) increased by 19.7% y/y to 0.73 USD.

### Quarterly results

The company's operating income reached 327.20 million USD (+34.9% y/y), while net income decreased by 3.1% y/y to 275.10 million USD. Earnings per share (GAAP) stood at 0.72 USD (+2.9% y/y), and earnings per share (GAAP, basic) remained unchanged compared to the previous year, at 0.73 USD (0.0% y/y).

### What management says

Management emphasized that despite market turbulence, the assessment of the company's opportunities remains unchanged, and the long-term plan inspires great confidence. According to management, reimbursement in international markets is maintaining a stable level. Management expects a decision regarding reimbursement for patients with diabetes not treated with insulin later this year. Management indicated that the publication of a study in a prestigious medical journal constitutes breakthrough evidence of the effectiveness of the company's systems, which, according to management, should significantly impact treatment standards. According to management, insurers typically provide equitable access to different systems, as patients, physicians, and employers strive to have a choice.

## Fundamentals #0053: American Electric Power: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-11-02 09:39
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-02-0053/


> ⚠️ **ERRATUM (2026-11-02)**  
> **The earnings per share guidance was described imprecisely.**
>
> **Corrections:**
> - 6.25–6.55 USD for 2026, 6.75–7.05 USD for 2027 and 7.40–7.70 USD for 2028 are guidance for operating earnings per share (excluding certain special items). The company maintained its 2026 guidance and provided the 2027 and 2028 guidance for the first time.
> - 6.11–6.41 USD is an estimate of 2026 earnings per share under accounting rules (GAAP), not a second guidance range.
>
> We corrected the description in the text; the figures stay the same.

American Electric Power (AEP) revenues increased in Q3 2026 by 13.7% y/y to 6.83 billion USD, and earnings per share (reported) increased by 19.8% y/y to 2.18 USD.

### Quarterly results

Adjusted earnings per share was 2.23 USD, representing a 23.9% y/y increase compared to 1.80 USD the previous year.

### Company guidance

The company maintains its guidance for operating earnings per share (excluding certain special items) in FY 2026 in the range of 6.25–6.55 USD and, for the first time, provides operating earnings per share guidance for FY 2027 of 6.75–7.05 USD and for FY 2028 of 7.40–7.70 USD. The range of 6.11–6.41 USD is an estimate of FY 2026 earnings per share under accounting rules (GAAP), not guidance.

### Management commentary

Management emphasized that they see a great deal of potential investment extending beyond the announced plan and that demand is already occurring, which requires the construction of new generation capacity. According to management, signed customer connection agreements in Texas are real, and despite adopting a cautious plan in this region, the company still sees strong growth there. Management also indicated that they view the idea of creating a separate generation company positively and are checking where it will bring the greatest benefits to customers. According to management, share issuances must increase earnings per share, as the company wants to remain cautious in managing shareholder capital.

## Fundamentals #0052: O'Reilly Automotive: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-11-02 09:36
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-02-0052/


> ⚠️ **ERRATUM (2026-11-02)**  
> **Two items of the company guidance were mislabelled.**
>
> **Corrections:**
> - 5.5% – 6.5% is the guidance for comparable store sales growth, not revenue growth.
> - 19.5% – 20.0% is the guidance for operating margin (operating income as a percentage of sales), not operating income growth.
>
> We corrected the labels in the text; the figures stay the same.

O'Reilly Automotive (ORLY) revenue in the third quarter was 5.12 billion USD (8.8% y/y), and earnings per share (reported) increased to 0.97 USD (12.8% y/y).

### Quarterly results

no data.

### Company guidance

For the full year 2026, the company expects revenue in the range of 19.00 billion USD – 19.30 billion USD, comparable store sales growth at the level of 5.5% – 6.5%, an operating margin (operating income as a percentage of sales) in the range of 19.5% – 20.0%, and gross margin at the level of 51.6% – 52.1%. Additionally, the company forecasts earnings per share in the range of 3.25–3.35 USD, capital expenditures in the order of 1.30 billion USD – 1.40 billion USD, free cash flow at the level of 1.90 billion USD – 2.20 billion USD, and a tax rate of 22.7%.

### What management says

Management expressed great satisfaction with comparable sales results, also after excluding exceptional factors. According to management, customers are in fairly good condition, although higher-income individuals are performing better than lowest-income customers. Management emphasized that new stores being opened in subsequent years are performing very well. According to management, the approach to debt and share buybacks remains unchanged, and the company is focusing on serving customers and gaining market share instead of trying to predict the weather. Management also noted that the industry is behaving rationally in terms of pricing and the company's approach to pricing policy will not change.

## Fundamentals #0051: PACCAR: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-11-02 09:32
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-02-0051/


PACCAR (PCAR) revenue in Q3 was 7.94 billion USD (+19.0% y/y), and net income increased by 43.6% y/y to 847.50 million USD.

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (GAAP) was 1.61 USD (+43.8% y/y), which is identical to the earnings per share (GAAP, diluted) result of 1.61 USD (+43.8% y/y).

### What management says

Management emphasized closer cooperation with suppliers to ensure parts necessary for truck production. According to management, customers are starting to place orders for next year, which is only the beginning of this process. Management expects further growth in parts sales by the end of the year and gaining market share. According to management, uncertainty should subside, and the market will strengthen over the next year. Management also mentioned that the new PACCAR Connect platform operates like an open system with applications that can generate additional revenue.

### Logbook: Gravitational Collapse and Volatility Expansion: Mass Shift Week

**1. Weekly Trajectory and Price Volatility (Session overview Monday–Friday)**
In the cycle 2026.10.26 — 2026.10.30, a rapid reconfiguration of all objects' trajectories occurred. the NDX Star moved from level 28956.83 to 28385.75, noting a drop of 571.08 pts (-1.97%) with high oscillation amplitude (1647.66 pts). the NQ Probe repeated this pattern, falling by 557.14 pts (-1.91%) within a wide movement range (1753.00 pts). the Dyson Sphere (QQQ) contracted by 13.77 USD (-1.96%). The entire system moved from an expansion phase to a strong compression phase, reaching weekly lows below opening levels, while simultaneously increasing oscillation amplitude compared to the previous cycle.

**2. Energy Balance and Cumulative Fuel (Weekly CVD and Volume)**
Despite the price decline, aggressive volume flow telemetry shows an anomalous energy balance. Cumulative CVD for NDX amounted to +318.26 M, which in Ghostwheel logic classifies as buying euphoria within a declining trajectory. the NQ Probe showed accumulation at the level of +10.47 K, and the QQQ Sphere recorded a massive energy injection (+4.22 M). The divergence between the negative price change and positive CVD suggests that aggressive volume entries occurred in high absorption zones, building a foundation for future reconfiguration.

**3. Mass Evolution, Core Densification, and Option Shields**
Total system mass (T-Mass) underwent erosion from 41.23 T to 40.17 T (-2.57%). However, an increase in Core density (>1T) from 66.20% to 68.19% was noted, indicating mass concentration in the largest singularities despite the general outflow of capital. Average action fell by 0.84% ($294.98). The system noted a sharp increase in pressure within option shields: implied volatility (IV) rose to 26.55% (weekly average: 22.95%), and the Put/Call OI ratio stabilized at 1.39. Background Radiation TICKQ (SMA200) at the level of +13.98 suggests testing demand resilience under conditions of increased fluctuation.

**Quantum Verdict:**
The system is in a state of high tension. There has been a degradation of total mass alongside a simultaneous densification of the core structure and aggressive energy accumulation (CVD). The physics of the system indicates preparation for a violent energy release or further compression under rising volatility.

**Status:** EXTERNAL OBSERVATION. Shields active.

**End of log.**

## Fundamentals #0050: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-10-30 15:36
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-30-0050/


Regeneron Pharmaceuticals (REGN) revenue in Q3 was 5.12 billion USD (+36.3% y/y), and earnings per share (GAAP) increased to 18.45 USD (+35.5% y/y).

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (GAAP, basic) reached 19.16 USD (+36.0% y/y), while earnings per share (adjusted) increased by 69.7% y/y to 20.07 USD. The company's operating income was 2.05 billion USD, representing an increase of 99.5% y/y compared to 1.03 billion USD a year earlier.

### What management says

Management emphasized that relations with partner Sanofi are very good, and the cooperation is on a strong track and open to new projects. According to management, the company is open to acquisitions and licenses at every stage of drug development, however, science decides the decisions. Management noted that when comparing external opportunities with their own research department, their own projects are usually selected. According to management, preparations for introducing a new drug for myasthenia are highly advanced. Management also emphasized that when entering new areas, such as obesity treatment, the company aims for solutions that realistically change the situation for patients, rather than just more similar drugs.

## Fundamentals #0049: Sandisk: 1Q2027 results

Date: 2026-10-30 11:17
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-30-0049/


Sandisk (SNDK) revenue increased in the first quarter of fiscal year 2027 to 11.03 billion USD (+377.9% y/y), and earnings per share (GAAP) reached 52.60 USD (+6,913.3% y/y).

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (GAAP, basic) was 55.49 USD (+7,106.5% y/y), while earnings per share (adjusted) stood at 49.51 USD (+3,958.2% y/y).

### Company guidance

In the second quarter of 2027, the company expects revenue in the range of 12.20 billion USD – 12.60 billion USD and adjusted earnings per share (non-GAAP) at the level of 55.00–57.00 USD.

### Management commentary

Management emphasized that the list of potential long-term customer contracts is very strong and growing, becoming the primary mode of collaboration. According to management, all segments of the flash memory market, including computers, smartphones, and data centers, will grow next year due to increased demand for memory in devices. Management stated that customers underestimated the demand for flash memory to run their infrastructure, and customer demand is strengthening compared to the previous quarter, with no impact from credit issues on the market. According to management, demand for SLC memory represents a more refined approach to system building and is not taking market share from other types of flash memory. Management also expressed the desire to continue operating debt-free while maintaining a very strong balance sheet and investing in the business.

## Fundamentals #0047: Monolithic Power Systems: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-10-30 00:23
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-29-0047/


Monolithic Power Systems (MPWR) revenue in the third quarter was 1.20 billion USD (+63.1% y/y), and earnings per share (adjusted) reached 8.19 USD (+73.2% y/y).

### Quarterly results

Gross margin was 55.4% (0.3 pp y/y), while operating income was 357.69 million USD (+83.3% y/y). Earnings per share (GAAP) was 5.51 USD (+47.3% y/y), and earnings per share (GAAP, basic) reached 5.53 USD (+47.5% y/y).

### What management says

Management assesses growth drivers very well, although they indicate it is still too early for next year's forecast. According to management, notebook sales are weaker due to memory shortages at manufacturers, but in the long term, this market is viewed optimistically thanks to technology and market share. Management emphasized that at the current growth rate, operating costs will come in below the company's model due to R&D efficiency. According to management, increasing production capacity should not require a large increase in capital expenditures or a change in capital structure. Management also noted that the company is not raising prices, but rather sharing part of the cost increase with customers.

## Fundamentals #0046: Mondelez International: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-10-30 00:20
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-29-0046/


Mondelez International (MDLZ) revenue in the third quarter was 9.97 billion USD (+2.3% y/y), and net income increased by 75.3% y/y to a level of 1.31 billion USD.

### Quarterly results

Operating income reached 1.76 billion USD (+136.3% y/y), while earnings per share (reported) and earnings per share (reported, basic) were 1.02 USD (+79.0% y/y). Adjusted earnings per share was at a level of 0.78 USD.

### Company guidance

The company expects free cash flows at a level of 3.00 billion USD.

### What management says

Management emphasized that consumer confidence in emerging markets remains resilient, and chocolate sales in Brazil are starting to rebound in terms of volume. According to management, the new promotion tactics in North America are yielding good results, and despite the weaker situation in China, the company views this market positively. Management indicated that surpluses will be reinvested in emerging markets and product innovations, and costs related to the war in the Middle East are included in the current guidance. According to management, cocoa inventories are at an appropriate level, allowing for the coverage of potential shortages, and regarding development, the company is not looking for large acquisitions, but rather targeted smaller purchases to fill regional and product gaps.

## Fundamentals #0045: Gilead Sciences: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-10-30 00:17
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-29-0045/


Gilead Sciences (GILD) revenue in the third quarter was 8.30 billion USD (+6.8% y/y), while earnings per share (GAAP) fell by 20.2% y/y to 1.94 USD.

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (GAAP, basic) was 1.96 USD (−20.3% y/y), while adjusted earnings per share increased by 3.2% y/y to 2.55 USD. Operating income reached 3.46 billion USD (+4.1% y/y), with an operating margin at 41.7% (−1.1 pp y/y).

### Management commentary

According to management, the HIV segment benefited from favorable pricing in certain channels and demand, and Biktarvy's market share continues to grow. Management emphasized that the company is focused on growth in the areas of oncology and inflammatory diseases. According to management, weekly oral HIV prevention is intended to reach individuals who prefer long-acting medications instead of injections. Management indicated that the way drug pricing is established under the IRA act may threaten investments in new products next year. According to management, the impact of new prices primarily concerns the Medicare program and manifests as a spillover effect to other sales channels. Management expressed satisfaction that the company absorbed the costs of newly acquired programs this year and intends to continue this process in the following years.


---

## Fundamentals #0044: Intel: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-10-29 23:55
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-29-0044/


Intel (INTC) revenue in the third quarter was 16.51 billion USD (+20.9% y/y), while earnings per share (GAAP) fell to 0.60 USD (−33.3% y/y).

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (GAAP, basic) reached 0.63 USD (−30.0% y/y), while earnings per share (adjusted) increased by 126.1% y/y to 0.52 USD. The company's operating income was 2.52 billion USD, representing a 269.2% y/y increase compared to 683.00 million USD a year earlier.

### Company guidance

In the fourth quarter of 2026, the company expects revenue in the range of 15.00 billion USD – 16.00 billion USD.

### What management says

Management expressed optimism regarding growth in the data center segment. According to management, the company may not generate positive free cash flows next year, as it views this period as an opportunity to invest in growth. Management indicated that capacity released by the weaker PC market can be allocated to data center wafers, however, substrate availability is also a constraint. According to management, the situation regarding memory availability next year is not optimistic. Management emphasized that external fab customers are expressing interest and are satisfied with the production yields, which the company is working intensively on. According to management, Panther Lake processor margins have clearly improved, although they have not yet reached the company-wide average.

## Fundamentals #0042: Xcel Energy: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-10-29 17:26
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-29-0042/


Xcel Energy (XEL) revenues increased in Q3 by 6.6% y/y to 4.17 billion USD, and earnings per share (reported) increased by 72.7% y/y to 1.52 USD.

### Quarterly results

no data.

### Company guidance

The company expects earnings per share in the range of 4.10 USD – 4.16 USD, 4.48 USD – 4.62 USD and 4.04 USD – 4.16 USD.

### Management commentary

Management emphasized that it is conducting advanced negotiations for an energy supply agreement with a large consumer, pointing to the greatest opportunities in the Midwest, Texas, and New Mexico regions. According to management, all investments serve customers through a focus on safety, reliability, and meeting the growing demand for electricity. Management noted that it wants to maintain a strong balance sheet, with plans to expect greater financial flexibility in the later years of the plan. According to management, data centers should self-fund the facilities being built for them, and the company will not connect facilities that do not benefit other customers. Management also indicated that oil companies are increasingly transitioning to electric power, which is driving electricity sales in the Texas and New Mexico region. According to management, combined-cycle gas power plants may become profitable in the future.

### Company guidance

The company expects fourth quarter revenue in the range of 1.70 billion USD – 1.73 billion USD, and forecasts full-year revenue at 6.39 billion USD – 6.42 billion USD.

Management also pointed to a belief in bundling services rather than strictly combining fixed and mobile telephony.

Honeywell Aerospace (HONA) revenues increased in the third quarter by 2.5% y/y to 4.64 billion USD, and earnings per share (reported) increased by 12.8% y/y to 2.29 USD.

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (reported, basic) was 2.29 USD (+12.8% y/y).

### Company guidance

For the full year 2026, the company expects organic growth at a level of 4.0% – 5.0%, adjusted earnings per share in the range of 7.85–8.00 USD, pro forma standalone adjusted EBIT of 4.38 billion USD – 4.42 billion USD, and free cash flows at a level of 1.20 billion USD – 1.40 billion USD.

Management indicated that the company is directing a larger number of deliveries toward US national security needs than to foreign customers, while the order backlog shows no declines. According to management, electronic component shortages have not significantly impacted operations, and no changes in customer behavior resulting from oil prices were observed in passenger aviation. Management also stated that negotiations for renewed contracts with manufacturers are proceeding as expected and will allow for a better alignment of prices with costs.

## Fundamentals #0035: Fortinet: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-10-29 01:49
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-10-29-0035/


Fortinet (FTNT) revenue in the third quarter of fiscal year 2026 was 2.08 billion USD (+20.5% y/y), and earnings per share (GAAP) increased to 0.86 USD (+38.7% y/y).

### Quarterly results

Operating income reached 704.30 million USD (+28.7% y/y), with net income amounting to 635.50 million USD (+34.1% y/y). Broken down by segments, Product segment revenue was 765.00 million USD (+36.8% y/y), while the Service segment generated 1.31 billion USD (+12.7% y/y). Earnings per share (GAAP, basic) was 0.87 USD (+38.1% y/y), while earnings per share (adjusted) fell to 0.05 USD (−58.3% y/y).

### What management says

Management emphasized that network security is a key element of AI protection, enabling better insight into traffic generated by these technologies. According to management, demand remains solid, and increasing threats are motivating customers to modernize security. Management indicated that the company does not see a slowdown in demand, although it notes lengthening delivery times. According to management, in the second half of the year, rising costs affected product margins, while service margins grew significantly. Management noted that customers deploying infrastructure do not always want to pay for services immediately, which represents only a shift in the timing of revenue recognition. According to management, more and more companies are launching their own open AI models, which increases the demand for their monitoring and securing.

Teradyne (TER) revenue in Q3 was 1.31 billion USD (+69.8% y/y), and earnings per share (GAAP) increased to 2.17 USD (+189.3% y/y).

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (GAAP, basic) stood at 2.19 USD (+192.0% y/y), while earnings per share (adjusted) was 2.29 USD (+169.4% y/y).

### Company guidance

In Q4 2026, the company expects revenue in the range of 1.25 billion USD – 1.35 billion USD, with adjusted earnings per share at 1.95–2.25 USD.

### Management commentary

Management expects significant growth in the memory segment in the coming year, which is expected to encompass all segments, with a particular focus on HBM technology. According to management, inventories are increasing due to preparations for growth and extended lead times for component deliveries for testers; therefore, the company is aggressively increasing production capacity in the area of memory testers and power test lines. Management emphasized that growth is expected to accelerate quarter by quarter in the coming year, although the company avoids specific forecasts due to the volatility of customer test line assembly cycles. According to management, the robotics portfolio is expanding, and solid growth is expected from the largest customer in the coming year. Management remains interested in co-packaged optics technology, but its development pace depends on profitability allowing for increased production.

Automatic Data Processing (ADP) revenues increased in the first quarter of fiscal year 2027 by 6.1% y/y to 5.49 billion USD, and earnings per share (reported) increased by 13.7% y/y to 2.83 USD.

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (reported, basic) was 2.84 USD (13.6% y/y).

### Company guidance

For the full fiscal year 2027, the company expects revenue growth of 6.0%, (adjusted) earnings per share growth in the range of 10.0% – 12.0%, and earnings per share growth of 12.0% – 14.0%. The company also forecasts interest income at 1.59 billion USD – 1.61 billion USD and a tax rate of 23.0%.
